test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Grim
solution: The correct answer is '**Stern**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Grim**' is '**Stern**'. • **Grim**: (used about a person) very serious; not smiling. [(व्‍यक्ति) गंभीर; अप्रफुल्लित] • *Example: The news is **grim**, I’m afraid.* • **Stern**: very serious; not smiling. (कठोर, बहुत गंभीर; मुस्‍कान-रहित) • *Example: a **stern** expression/warning...* **Correct Answer:__** *Stern.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Forceful**: having the power to persuade people. (लोगों को प्रेरित करने की शक्ति से युक्त; शक्तिशाली, प्रभावशाली) • **Joyful**: very happy. (बहुत प्रसन्‍न, ख़ुश या आनंदित) • **Arrogant**: thinking that you are better and more important than other people. (अक्‍खड़, घमंडी, अभिमानी) 31:Tb3f, The correct answer is '**Melodous**'.
